summary: OpenAI announced that ChatGPT can now connect to healthcare organizations' EHR systems and other industry data sources to give clinicians access to patient context and medical research.

categories.reason: The announcement describes ChatGPT connecting to clinical EHR systems for clinician use, crossing into care workflows.
categories.quote: Healthcare organizations can now connect EHR and additional industry data to ChatGPT.

practices.reason: Connecting ChatGPT to EHR and healthcare data sources introduces new data integration surfaces that healthcare-adjacent engineering teams would need to build against.
practices.quote: ChatGPT can now connect to trusted healthcare data, helping clinicians securely access patient context, medical research, and more.
